The '''Republic Navy War College''', also known as the '''Anaxes War College''', was a military [[academy]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] based on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Anaxes/Legends|Anaxes]]. Considered the embodiment of [[Navy/Legends|naval]] tradition for centuries, the War College later became a prominent [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] institution before falling under the control of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]].

==History==
Based at [[Anaxes Citadel]], the War College trained officers for the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] after they had passed out of basic training at the [[Imperial Naval Academy/Legends|Naval Academy]] on [[Prefsbelt IV/Legends|Prefsbelt IV]]. Even in periods when the Republic lacked a standing military, it was romanticised in [[Holodrama/Legends|holodramas]].<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

After the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformations]] of [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] dissolved the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]], the War College became largely moribund. In the aftermath of the [[Mandalorian Excision]], it was revived in [[738 BBY]] as a joint effort by the [[Planetary Security Forces]] as the '''College of Planetary Security Forces'''. This resulted in a restoration of naval tradition that was used as a model when the Republic Navy was reestablished in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare p.50">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

The Republic Navy War College was reestablished during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], when the Galactic Republic began to centralize its military forces once again. It made the [[Anaxes War College System/Legends|Anaxes War College System]] to classify [[Starship/Legends|starships]], in particular [[Warship/Legends|warships]], based on their size and capabilities. The system made by the college during the Republic era was used by subsequent galactic governments.

Following the [[Declaration of a New Order]], the War College became a division of the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]]. [[Cadet/Legends|Cadets]] who had passed out of basic training at the [[Imperial Naval Academy/Legends|Imperial Naval Academy]] on [[Prefsbelt IV/Legends|Prefsbelt IV]] might attend advanced training on Anaxes. The War College offered active training and combat simulations, and also served as a think tank for promising cadets and active-duty Imperial officers. The War College also tested new warships and equipment for the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] in training cruises.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare p.50" />

The War College fell under [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] control in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]]. As late as [[127 ABY]], it was still active as a training establishment for officers of the [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet]].<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare p.50" />
